column1: # Ireland: the Islamic Foundation of Ireland's fixed table (islamicfoundation.ie, printed in GMT for 28 towns; Dublin's
# column as local time), the table for Dublin (ruling R44). No imsak is printed: Fajr is also the start of the fast.
# IFI's Fajr and Isha curves (IfiCurve) are fitted to this same table, and it repeats every year, so nothing is held
# out. Lucan's copy differs only in its summer Isha (its own, earlier); the second Dublin capture (ifi_dublin_b) is
# another town's column, unnamed, and is not used.
